raw.query:
WITH current_runs AS (
  SELECT run_id, window_name, superseded_by,
         (regexp_match(run_id, '^g6:u([0-9]+)__(burst[345])__fc_L30__(g25|g100)$'))[1]::int AS image_px,
         replace((regexp_match(run_id, '^g6:u([0-9]+)__(burst[345])__fc_L30__(g25|g100)$'))[3], 'g', '')::int AS fabric_gbps
  FROM provenance.v_dim
  WHERE is_current = true AND superseded_by IS NULL
    AND run_id ~ '^g6:u(224|336|448|672)__(burst3|burst4|burst5)__fc_L30__(g25|g100)$'
), burst AS (
  SELECT d.image_px, d.fabric_gbps, d.window_name, p.p99_ms, p.n_requests, p.queue_divergent
  FROM current_runs d
  JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p ON p.run_id = d.run_id
  WHERE p.is_current = true AND p.sla_metric = 'encoder_delay'
), bound AS (
  SELECT bound_ms FROM provenance.v_sla_bound
  WHERE sla_metric = 'encoder_delay' AND bound_stat = 'p99'
), cells AS (
  SELECT image_px, fabric_gbps, count(*) AS window_denominator,
         sum(n_requests) AS request_denominator,
         min(p99_ms) AS min_p99_ms, max(p99_ms) AS max_p99_ms,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE p99_ms <= bound_ms) AS passing_windows,
         bool_or(queue_divergent) AS any_queue_divergent
  FROM burst CROSS JOIN bound
  GROUP BY image_px, fabric_gbps
), collector AS (
  SELECT image_px, mean_ms AS aic_f64_ms
  FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn
  WHERE is_valid = true AND engine = 'aic' AND n_images = 64
    AND source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/aic_multires.json'
    AND image_px IN (448,672)
), fast AS (
  SELECT max(max_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE image_px=448) AS p99_448,
         max(max_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE image_px=672) AS p99_672
  FROM cells WHERE fabric_gbps=100
)
SELECT 'cell' AS row_type, image_px, fabric_gbps, window_denominator, request_denominator,
       round(min_p99_ms::numeric,3) AS min_p99_ms,
       round(max_p99_ms::numeric,3) AS max_p99_ms,
       passing_windows, any_queue_divergent,
       NULL::numeric AS crossing_px_area, NULL::numeric AS crossing_px_linear,
       NULL::double precision AS aic_f64_448_ms, NULL::double precision AS aic_f64_672_ms,
       (SELECT bound_ms FROM bound) AS bound_ms
FROM cells
UNION ALL
SELECT 'crossing', NULL, 100, NULL, NULL,
       round(f.p99_448::numeric,3), round(f.p99_672::numeric,3), NULL, NULL,
       round(sqrt(448.0^2 + (1000.0-f.p99_448)/(f.p99_672-f.p99_448)*(672.0^2-448.0^2))::numeric,3),
       round((448.0 + (1000.0-f.p99_448)/(f.p99_672-f.p99_448)*(672.0-448.0))::numeric,3),
       max(c.aic_f64_ms) FILTER (WHERE c.image_px=448),
       max(c.aic_f64_ms) FILTER (WHERE c.image_px=672),
       (SELECT bound_ms FROM bound)
FROM fast f CROSS JOIN collector c
GROUP BY f.p99_448, f.p99_672
ORDER BY row_type, image_px, fabric_gbps
raw.observed: For each 224, 336, and 448 px cell on 25 and 100 Gbps, passing_windows=3 of window_denominator=3 against the 1000 ms p99 bound; 448 px p99 is 588.370 ms at 25 Gbps and 384.519 ms at 100 Gbps. At 672 px, 100 Gbps is 938.734 ms while 25 Gbps is 1397.399 ms. Interpolation of the 100 Gbps floor gives crossings of 692.328 px by area and 696.762 px linearly.
raw.claimed: Burst-window verdict holds at 448^2 and below on both modelled fabrics; service floor crosses the bound near 690--705 px; assumed 448 px resolution lies below it.
raw.evidence: Current, non-superseded burst3/4/5 rows pass at every tested resolution through 448 px on both fabrics, and both interpolation forms place the 100 Gbps crossing inside 690--705 px.
